text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day, Epiphaneia was reading through 
the fan letters sent to her. However—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. What should I do about this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'm terribly indecisive, so whenever I 
have to make a choice, I always waver. How 
about you, Epi?"—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hesitating when it's time to decide? What 
does that feel like?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
――I don't get it! But I'm sure you're in 
real trouble, right?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go, Trainer! Let's meet her 
and blow all her worries away!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey there! Thanks as always for your 
support! I'm so happy to see you!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
Th-The pleasure is mine... I never 
imagined Epi-san would contact me...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You looked like something was bothering 
you! Alright, let's head out right away.

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, you're going...? P-Please wait, 
Epi-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's sit here! I'm getting the 
Seasonal Deluxe Parfait! What about you?

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm sorry. I'm... so slow at 
deciding...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind at all! If you can't decide, 
how about getting the same parfait as me?"

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
N-No... Um... That's a bit too much for 
me, so I'll go with this cake instead.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Hm? That's that horror manga I've been 
curious about! I should buy the whole 
series! How about you grab some too?

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not good with scary things, so... I 
think I'll buy this shojo manga instead.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Whew! You're really good! Alright, let's 
do a duet next!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
A-A duet with Epi-san...! ...Yes! It'll be 
an honor!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What, there's no problem at all! Look at 
you, able to make decisions on your own!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
N-No! Today, well... I just got swept up 
in Epi's momentum. Usually it takes me a 
lot longer.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Take all the time you need! To be honest, 
I still don't quite get the whole 
"struggling to make up your mind" feeling, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Deciding things for yourself, based on 
your own feelings. Surely, that's what 
matters most. Don't you think so too?"

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
Decide for myself... Right, even if it 
takes time, I always—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haha, look at that bright expression on 
your face! You're gonna be just fine now! 
You finally realized what you're capable 
of!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the young fan nod in relief, I 
truly realized once more how dependable 
Epiphaneia is.
